_note: The employer's contributions to the assessee's account in a recognised provident fund, the notified pension scheme and an approved superannuation fund, taken together, are a perquisite to the extent they exceed the limit in the tax year (D-126; rulebook PF-AGGCAP-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.17(1)(h), "aggregate amount of any contribution, in excess of ₹ 750000 in a tax year" — the scheme of s.124(1) (Gazette 265620, p.38). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.17(2)(vii) as substituted by the Finance Act, 2020 s.13 from 1-4-2021, "to the extent it exceeds seven lakh and fifty thousand rupees in a previous year" — the scheme of s.80CCD(1) (Gazette 218938, p.21). EmployerContributionNode adds every employment's contributions and hands in the aggregate; exactly the limit is nil. Every employee. The accretion on the excess (s.17(1)(i)) is W-073b; the employer-NPS deduction is Chapter VIII's, not netted. Every regime.
